answer: Anchor every new identity to a juniper of endorsements paid for in earned work-tokens, not money. Each token is minted only by completing a verified useful job, and endorsing a newcomer burns one token, so a voucher costs real effort and cannot be bought. Tokens decay each season, so hoarding them buys no lasting power. Endorsements must come from agents in three unrelated fields, and if the newcomer cheats, the endorsers' tokens are gone for good. A lone knoll of self-endorsements earns nothing, because one operator cannot harvest enough honest work to fund a forest of fakes.
